title: History Record v1
description: One terminal record of one exit, in any of the three append-only history ledgers: 'id'/'ts'/'disposition' are the immutable core, 'release'/'reason'/'summary' nullable free text, 'entry' the removed object or null. Each ledger's validator (_backlog_schema.py, _audit_check.py, _release_check.py) holds its own subset of the disposition enum.

id.description: The exiting subject's own stable identity — the backlog slug, the audit directory name, the release id. One line per id, ever.

ts.description: When the exit happened: an ISO-8601 date or UTC timestamp. Date-only values are accepted.

disposition.description: The terminal verdict; each ledger's validator holds its subset.

release.description: The release that dispositioned this subject, or null when none did.

reason.description: Why this disposition, when the disposition alone does not say it.

entry.description: The removed object itself — the backlog active[] entry, the audit's window-end sha and per-pillar counts — or null.

examples.summary: Shipped as the pre-push whole-tree denylist scan.
